doc.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Recordings as a leader and the Getz years
title: People Time releases and the seven-CD set
summary: Brown and Barron sort out the issues of People Time, including the full seven-CD release.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: The record – the historical record’s showing that it’s from 1986 to – then People Time was 1991. Then some people say ’92. I’m not sure if the confusions for that is – because when I went to go pick it up, there were two different issues. There was one that was a single CD. Then the one that was more recently released is a double LP with – so there must – you said there were two concerts. Maybe they released the stuff . . .
Yeah, I think People Time was originally two CDs.
Was it? Okay. Because I – then maybe the new one has some other additions for
Oh no. It just came out again.
Is it seven? Okay. That’s what it is.
They released everything, sound checks, everything. Yeah, it’s seven CDs.

Yeah. Some of it – because, you know, there’s a sound check. So you’re not giving 100%. Plus they were also – they were messing with the sound, just trying to get the balance right. So you can hear the saxophone go up and down, or . . .
